author: Rich33
quote: A good 8, and I can easily see why some have given it a 9. Doesn't get the respect it deserves as a really good soulslike. Not as difficult as some make out if you are sensible about your build and embrace its features - as per any game in this genre.

author: Rich33
quote:
The best, most inventive, 3D platformer I have played, and an absolute performance/graphics masterclass.
Great fun, makes you laugh and an easy 10.

author: Rich33
quote:
Fantastic story and gameplay. Length is ok, and replayable.
Graphics and Technicals are incredible, and no other next gen console game even gets close except previous insomniac games and maybe GOWR. 1440 resolution (there are a few drops when moving fast but you dont notice), at 65-80fps, with ray tracing, and incredible detail at distance & traversal speed. Insane loading speed. Performance - uncapped - 120hz auto.

author: Rich33
quote:
Edit: updated after Patch 5, 18/5. Performance still completely unacceptable after this latest patch. Hogwarts performance makes Jedi look last gen. Still a 0.
This game could easily be a 9 or 10 if not for the unacceptable performance and screen tear in the so called performance mode. A number of PS5 games look much much better than this and run at stable 60, with some running at 80 plus fps (and higher fidelity).
So sad because there is a lot of good here it is just being completely overshadowed by performance issues.

author: Rich33
quote:
Edit: after patches this games fps performance has been significantly improved, despite it running at an already decent more or less locked 60 at launch. Now looks amazing.
A really good, fun game. Some minor issues (why is supefy not coloured red?!) made up for by the game just being a fantastic overall package with lots to do and see. Very deep combat system, particularly on its hardest difficulty, with fantastic curse mechanics and choices.

author: Rich33
quote:
Ignore all the haters spouting their w*ke garbage, this is a good, fun, game. (Note - 1st bought and played in Dec 22 after multiple patches which seem to have resolved all the serious bugs which stopped me buying at launch). Very tongue in cheek humour, that seems to poke fun at itself more often than not. As a long time fan of the series until 4 got a bit too OTT for my tastes, this felt more like SR2-3 in tone.
Technically its just alright but nothing special (play in 1440 High framerate), and it does have a few plot fumbles or I would have given a 9.

author: Rich33
